input_types: One UTF-8 JSON object conforming to ignition-portable-research-episode-r0 on stdin; maximum 262144 bytes.
required_outputs: Bounded deterministic JSON with schema and cross-reference status, typed findings and warnings, artifact/execution/review/omission/fork-map counts, and explicit non-authorization/non-import/non-byte-verification flags.
Per-execution declared status and counts of used, attached and produced artifact references, without treating those caller declarations as authenticated events.
